source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Recolor the full-width horizontal bars and the continuous vertical bar.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == 8 for v in row):
            out[r] = [2] * w
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h)):
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
